name: Ca Mau Marathon 2026 - Petrovietnam Cup
short_description: Ca Mau Marathon 2026, the Petrovietnam Cup, is on Sunday 15 November 2026 at the Ca Mau provincial convention centre, over 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, 21 km and 42 km.
ai_summary: The Ca Mau Marathon 2026 Petrovietnam Cup is on Sunday 15 November 2026, based at the Ca Mau provincial convention centre in An Xuyen ward, with VietRace365 as the listed organiser. It is part of the "Ca Mau - Destination 2026" programme and the Ca Mau Shrimp Festival, and marks 65 years of Petrovietnam. Distances are 42 km, 21 km, 10 km, 5 km and a 2 km kids' run.

core_facts.venue: Ca Mau provincial convention centre, An Xuyen ward

faqs.question: What are the cut-off times at Ca Mau Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The rules set 6 hours 30 minutes for the 42 km, 3 hours 30 minutes for the 21 km, 2 hours 30 minutes for the 10 km, 90 minutes for the 5 km and 45 minutes for the 2 km kids' run. Minimum ages are 18 for the marathon, 16 for the half and 12 for 10 km.

faqs.question: Who can enter the Ca Mau Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The rules describe entrants as athletes from provinces in Vietnam and from abroad who live or work in Vietnam, plus officials, workers and students in Ca Mau and staff of Petrovietnam units. Runners with a history of heart or respiratory illness are barred, and each runner may enter only one distance.
